_comment: Phase 5 animated tiles. Tile id -> how that tile moves. Levels never mention this: the renderer looks every drawn tile up here, so adding an entry animates every existing level at once. Ids match data/tiles.json and are never changed by animation - collision reads the id, not the frame.

_effects.frames: indices into the fx atlas above, cycled at 'fps'
_effects.sway: draw offset in px along 'axis'; 'row_phase' staggers successive tile rows so foliage ripples instead of sliding as one sheet
_effects.tint: brightness multiplier swinging +/- 'amount' at 'hz' - a light source that breathes
